layout.body:
Dear Ms. Nguyen,
We're excited to invite you—and your friends and family—to the grand opening of our new branch at 25 Orchid Street, happening next Monday. This event is a great opportunity to explore our state-of-the-art facility, featuring top-tier equipment, energizing group classes, and expert personal training.
This celebrating, exclusively for our valued members and their guests, will include guided tours, live fitness demonstrations, and complimentary refreshments. It's the perfect chance to experience our community-focused approach to wellness and introduce others to a space designed for all fitness levels.
Bring your friends and family! We're offering a special one-day-only discount on memberships for all attendees.
For questions or to RSVP, contact our customer service team at 555-1234.
Warm regards,
John Parker

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the email?

options.A: To attract customers to a new fitness center
options.B: To provide Ms. Nguyen with an opportunity to provide expert personal training
options.C: To celebrate Ms. Nguyen’s achievements in wellness
options.D: To announce a discount available to fitness-center members

questions.analysis: What is the main purpose of the email? 原文依据：invite you... to the grand opening of our new branch... explore our state-of-the-art facility 邀请您参加我们新分店的盛大开业…… 参观我们的先进设施 (A) 吸引顾客到新的健身中心 → 正确 (B) 为 Nguyen 女士提供专家私人教练的机会 → 错误 (C) 庆祝 Nguyen 女士在健康方面的成就 → 错误 (D) 宣布给健身中心会员的折扣 → 错误

questions.stem: What can be inferred about Ms. Nguyen’s relationship with the fitness center?

options.A: She helps the fitness center to organize activities.
options.B: She has already explored the new facility.
options.C: She is a member at one of the fitness center’s other locations.
options.D: She is new to using fitness centers and exercise equipment.

questions.analysis: What can be inferred about Ms. Nguyen's relationship with the fitness center? 原文依据：exclusively for our valued members and their guests 仅限我们尊贵的会员及其嘉宾参加 (A) 她帮助健身中心组织活动 → 错误 (B) 她已经参观过新设施 → 错误 (C) 她是健身中心其他分店的会员 → 正确 (D) 她是初次使用健身中心和运动器材 → 错误

questions.stem: The new fitness center is intended for use by which of the following groups of people?

options.D: Community members of all fitness levels

questions.analysis: The new fitness center is intended for use by which of the following groups of people? 原文依据：a space designed for all fitness levels 为所有健身水平的人设计的场地 (A) 专业私人教练 → 错误 (B) 顶级运动员 → 错误 (C) 现有健身中心会员 → 错误 (D) 所有健身水平的社区成员 → 正确
